summary: Delivered LinkFree's CRA 5/webpack 5 build lanes. Added one generic adapter capability (createCraJavaScriptJsxPlugin) for JSX in application-source JavaScript — the only break react-scripts 5 surfaced — with unit tests and 'linkfree' added to the overfitting guard. Baseline rebuilt x2 and measured byte-stable; Vite 8 lane built x2 deterministic; both digests reproduced across two full orchestration runs. purgecss declared out of the Vite build's scope with both lanes measured (619824->50728; 587122->43283) and the baseline measurement proven to reproduce the shipped stylesheet. Corpus paths folded into per-lane aggregate digests so no contributor filename enters evidence. tsc, lint (0 errors), and 1380 node tests green.
